description: This file defines a React component 'FilmStrip' and related components for visualizing screencast frames and a film strip UI in a trace viewer application. It includes rendering logic for frames, hover previews, and layout calculations.

classes.name: FilmStrip
classes.description: React component for displaying a sequence of screencast frames as a film strip with hover preview.

classes.name: FilmStripLane
classes.description: React component for rendering a lane of screencast frames within the film strip.

methods.name: timeComparator
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting frames by timestamp.

methods.name: inscribe
methods.description: Calculates scaled size to fit an object within a given area while preserving aspect ratio.
